title: Beautiful Santa Rosa Home: Perfect Family Vacation
h1: Beautiful Santa Rosa Home: Perfect Family Vacation
meta_description: This peaceful and stylish coastal home is located in a premiere NatureWalk Neighborhood. Beautiful, spacious, porches look out over long stretch of gr...
description_expanded: This peaceful and stylish coastal home is located in a premiere NatureWalk Neighborhood. Beautiful, spacious, porches look out over long stretch of green space and trees for kids to run and play--enjoy seasonally heated pools & convenient community center all in the heart of Scenic 30A. This home is brand new to the rental market & is in pristine condition. This home borders WaterColor & is 5 mins. to Seaside. This home has 3 king beds and 1 queen bed. The home features four beautifully appointed bedrooms, each designed for comfort and relaxation. The first-floor king bedroom offers a private retreat, while the primary bedroom boasts a king-size bed. Upstairs, you'll find two more king bedrooms and a queen bedroom, all providing ample space for your group. The home includes three full bathrooms, ensuring convenience for all guests. Enjoy the convenience of a fully equipped kitchen complete with a refrigerator, oven, stove, microwave, dishwasher, and coffee maker, perfect for preparing delicious meals. Additional amenities include a washer and dryer, air conditioning, internet access, and a TV for your entertainment. Relax and unwind on the patio or balcony, and take advantage of the community pool and beach access for endless fun. Enjoy access to all areas of this beautiful home! You'll have private access to all four bedrooms, three full bathrooms, the fully-equipped kitchen with stainless steel appliances, and the comfortable living areas. Step outside onto the two covered patios/porches with seating. Guests can also enjoy the community amenities including seasonally heated pools, the fire pit, sand volleyball court, sport courts, and hammocks at The Gathering Place. Plus, take advantage of the beach walk to the famed 30A beaches. Nestled in the heart of NatureWalk, this home offers unparalleled access to the best of Santa Rosa Beach. A short stroll or bike ride will take you to the pristine sugar-white sands and emerald waters of the 30A beaches via the private Lilly Lane beach walk. For dining and shopping, WaterColor Crossing is just a stone's throw away, offering a variety of restaurants, boutiques, and a convenient Publix grocery store (walking distance). Within NatureWalk itself, you'll find The Gathering Place, a hub of activity featuring pools, hot tubs, a fire pit, and hammocks. Explore the area's natural beauty with numerous nature trails, perfect for a leisurely walk or bike ride. Seaside, with its charming shops and renowned restaurants, is just a quick 5-minute drive away, making this location ideal for a memorable vacation. We are available to assist you throughout your stay! You can reach us via your chosen platform with any questions or concerns. We typically respond within a few hours, but rest assured—we’ll do our best to get back to you as quickly as possible. For urgent matters, please note it in your message. We’re committed to ensuring you have a fantastic vacation experience! Please note if any beach chairs, umbrellas, toys, coolers, pack n plays, and baby gear are available, these are provided as a complimentary amenity. LUXE 30A does not guarantee the inclusion or perfect working order of these items. They are not part of the rental agreement. The primary renter must be 25 years of age or older, with at least one guest aged 25+ for every three guests in the group. Street parking is not allowed. Getting around is easy! Free parking is available on the premises for your convenience. For those flying in, Northwest Florida Beaches International Airport (ECP) is approximately a 30-minute drive away. While public transportation is limited in this area, ride-sharing services are readily available. The home's prime location in NatureWalk allows for easy access to many amenities by foot or bike, including WaterColor Crossing (Publix, dining, shopping). Seaside is just a 5-minute drive.
